listings.short: See what actually happened in a Claude Code session: which model answered, where the tokens went, what compaction threw away.
Find the Claude Code failures that produce no error message: dead hooks, rejected skills, missing plugins, oversized CLAUDE.md.
Diagnose a failed or slow Claude Code turn from the session log: upstream quota, relay fault, transport, or a retry that hid itself.
One offline HTML page of your Claude Code history - no server, no scripts, no network.
Where Claude Code spend went, per model and per prompt - cross-checked against which model actually answered.
